criterion_text: Patients must not have received prior systemic chemotherapy.
patient_excerpt: 47-year-old man with newly diagnosed metastatic colorectal cancer. Adjuvant FOLFOX completed 3 years ago after R0 resection.
reasoning: Requirement: patient must have NO prior systemic chemotherapy. Patient received FOLFOX (a systemic chemo) adjuvantly. Criterion makes no temporal carve-out, so the negative requirement is violated.

patient_excerpt: 62-year-old woman with stage III ovarian cancer. PMH unremarkable; ECG within normal limits, no chest pain or dyspnea on exertion.
reasoning: Requirement: absence of clinically significant CV disease. Patient note explicitly states unremarkable PMH and a normal ECG. The negative condition (no significant CV disease) holds.

criterion_text: Patient has no known hypersensitivity to platinum agents.
patient_excerpt: 58-year-old with NSCLC. PMH includes hypertension, type 2 diabetes. Allergies: shellfish.
reasoning: Requirement: absence of platinum hypersensitivity. Patient note lists shellfish allergy but does not mention any prior platinum exposure or reaction. Cannot infer absence (never tested) — NEI.

criterion_text: Patients without progression-free interval of less than 6 months on prior therapy.
patient_excerpt: Stage IV NSCLC. Received osimertinib 8 months ago, progressed at month 9 (PFI = 9 months).
reasoning: Double negation: 'without PFI < 6 months' = PFI must be ≥ 6 months. Patient PFI is 9 months, which satisfies the requirement.

criterion_text: Subject has no prior treatment that did not include a checkpoint inhibitor.
patient_excerpt: Melanoma stage IV. Prior therapy: ipilimumab + nivolumab combination (2 cycles), discontinued due to colitis.
reasoning: Parsing: 'no prior treatment that did not include a checkpoint inhibitor' → all prior treatments included a checkpoint inhibitor. Patient's only prior tx (ipi+nivo) is checkpoint-based. Met.

criterion_text: Absence of any uncontrolled non-malignant systemic disease.
patient_excerpt: 45yo with breast cancer. PMH: HTN well-controlled on lisinopril, T2DM HbA1c 6.8% on metformin.
reasoning: Double negative pattern: 'absence of uncontrolled non-malignant disease'. Patient comorbidities (HTN, T2DM) are documented as well-controlled. Negative requirement satisfied.

criterion_text: No history of stroke or transient ischemic attack within the past 6 months.
patient_excerpt: 71yo with pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Hospitalized 9 months ago for left-sided weakness, MRI confirmed lacunar infarct. Has been stable since.
reasoning: Requirement: no stroke/TIA in last 6 months. Patient had an infarct 9 months ago — outside the 6-month window. Within-window requirement is satisfied.

criterion_text: No history of malignancy other than the disease under study within 5 years.
patient_excerpt: 55yo woman with metastatic breast cancer (current). PMH: ductal carcinoma in situ left breast diagnosed and treated with lumpectomy 2 years ago.
reasoning: Requirement: no other malignancy within 5 years. Patient had DCIS (a malignancy) diagnosed 2 years ago — within the 5-year window. Requirement violated.

criterion_text: Patient has no history of immunodeficiency, including HIV.
patient_excerpt: 33yo with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Recent CD4 count 740. No known immunodeficiency disorders documented.
reasoning: Requirement: no immunodeficiency, including HIV. Patient has normal CD4 (740 cells/µL is normal range) and no documented disorder. Negative requirement supported by data.

criterion_text: Patient denies symptoms of active infection.
patient_excerpt: 68yo with renal cell carcinoma. Reports persistent productive cough × 2 weeks; chest X-ray ordered, awaiting results. Denies fever or chills.
reasoning: Requirement: patient denies active-infection symptoms. While the patient denies fever, they report a 2-week productive cough — itself a symptom of possible active infection (e.g., pneumonia). The negative claim of 'no active infection symptoms' is contradicted.

criterion_text: Subject denies any prior radiation to the chest.
patient_excerpt: 49yo with esophageal cancer. Received chest XRT (50.4 Gy) for prior Hodgkin lymphoma at age 22.
reasoning: Requirement: no prior chest radiation. Patient explicitly received 50.4 Gy chest XRT for Hodgkin lymphoma. The 'denies' condition is contradicted by documented history.

criterion_text: Patient denies use of investigational agents within the past 30 days.
patient_excerpt: 60yo with metastatic prostate cancer. Currently on standard-of-care abiraterone + prednisone. No mention of investigational drug use.
reasoning: Requirement: no investigational agents in last 30 days. Abiraterone and prednisone are both FDA-approved standard care. Patient denies (implicitly via absence) investigational use. Reasonable to accept as met.
